title: 🌺 Better Anti-AFK
features:
⚠️ This script wasn't made by me, this script was made by e621 (https://scriptblox.com/u/e621). 

This Anti-AFK script will remove the 20-minute kick timer from Roblox, allowing you to safely AFK while autofarming!
